strength: Cheap, no-downtime two-player design with a clear hook (the visible cooling row), good seat balance (gap 1.4) and a large skill gap (75 points).
weakness: Early fog-flip luck decides most games (runaway 0.79, 1.5 lead changes, coin-flip round 1), and the signature reading layer is worth only about 5 points, so the game does not yet deliver the outguess-your-rival experience.
required_changes: Reduce early-fog luck (more 1s and 2s, fewer Mines, or free peeks at setup) - runaway leader 0.79 toward 0.65, lead changes 1.5 toward 2
Add a real comeback beyond torpedoes (hit protection, trailer bonus) - lead changes >= 2 without making torpedo spam dominant (E1 stays <= 50%)
Make Sonar matter (reveal two steps or peek at a face-down card) - dead cards = 0, never-ping win rate <= 45%
Stop leaders coasting at the round-10 cap (cap 12 or early-end rule) - runaway leader, length within 12-18 min
Raise the value of reading the cooling row - blind-vs-reading gap above 10 points
Close all 6 ambiguities and cut sub-rules (consider removing Reef bounce clash and Sonar-as-points) - ambiguities = 0, panel rules_simplicity above 0.09
Compare against Creep in Silent and make differences explicit - originality score
revision_reason: Yes: the core loop, seat balance and skill gap are healthy and each failure is narrow with a named KPI; if revision 1 does not bring runaway below 0.70, park it.
